description: This file defines the FirmwareFlasher class, responsible for providing a GUI component to flash firmware onto a device, specifically handling firmware flashing logic, user confirmation, and external command execution.

classes.name: FirmwareFlasher
classes.description: A GUI component that manages firmware flashing, including user prompts, executing external commands like OpenOCD, and displaying status messages.

methods.name: FirmwareFlasher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the firmware flasher with the target filename and button label.

methods.name: getOpenocdCommad
methods.description: Generates and returns the command string for invoking OpenOCD with the appropriate configuration.

methods.name: doFlashFirmware
methods.description: Performs the firmware flashing process by verifying file existence, executing external commands, and handling error messages.
